summary:
Does your dashboard take minutes to appear? Games freeze while they load? Updates fail halfway, or you see "Something went wrong" with E100, E101, E102 or E106?

On an Xbox One, that's nearly always the internal hard drive wearing out. Every model still boots from a mechanical drive, and most are now seven years old or more.

We fit a new drive and reinstall the system software. That costs from R1,800 for the original Xbox One, One S, One S All-Digital and One X. We can also quote an SSD upgrade in place of the hard drive.

Every job includes a free diagnostic and a 6-month warranty. Bring it to Silvercrest Shopping Centre or book R300 collection across Gauteng.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
